card.name: "of" after strongest predictors
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after "predictors" in the antidepressant suicide-risk warning, in the phrase "the strongest predictors of suicide".

modes.label: of after predictors
modes.description: The word "of" following "strongest predictors" just before "suicide" in a warning about depression and suicide risk.
modes.example: and these disorders themselves are the strongest predictors<< of>> suicide.

card.plain: It fires on the little word "of" in the phrase "strongest predictors of suicide" in a depression warning.
